_about: Parity guard of the web front-end (tests/web/test_parity_guard.py). Every address the core's describe() lists must be bound to a control on the page (an element with data-address) or match a pattern below, with the reason it is absent. Patterns are fnmatch globs. A slice that binds an address removes it from here (the guard fails while a bound address is still listed, and on patterns that match nothing).

absent.global.edit_all: edit rack header: edit all (edit rack slice)
absent.ch?.osc.wave: edit rack oscillator section (edit rack slice; tune and decay are on the strips)
absent.ch?.osc.freq: edit rack oscillator section (edit rack slice; tune and decay are on the strips)
